channel.title: How to create a custom Whonix workstation (Ubuntu/WIN) in QEMU/KVM kicksecure?
channel.description:
I need to install Bluestacks. It is supported only on Windows. All other android emulators are getting detected for being virtualized.
I find it impossible to create a Ubuntu, Windows VM in QEMU KVM that behaves as a Whonix workstation. I want to route the Windows VM traffic through the gateway. I find it impossible because I have this message "Libvirt connection does not support virtual network managment".
The only solution I find is to delete kicksecure and install debian... Can I do it in Kicksecure ?

item.title: How to create a custom Whonix workstation (Ubuntu/WIN) in QEMU/KVM kicksecure?
item.dc:creator: spartack
item.description:
What you need to do is to connect the Workstation to the internal network to be able to communicate with the Gateway. Afterwards check /etc/network/interfaces.d/ and/etc/resolv.conf to redirect all the traffic through the Gateway. The workstation shouldn’t have external connection by itself, just through the Gateway by static IP.

item.title: How to create a custom Whonix workstation (Ubuntu/WIN) in QEMU/KVM kicksecure?
item.dc:creator: arraybolt3
item.description:
Anonymize Other Operating Systems has instructions for making a Custom-Whonix-Workstation. The instructions for doing so with KVM are likely out of date since we switched to using the QEMU/KVM user session in libvirt for security reasons. VirtualBox may function better. Anonymizing other operating systems isn’t officially supported, but someone on the Whonix forums may be able to help. They may also be able to help with getting KVM to work if you must use it.

(This is kind of off-topic here but not entirely since you’re dealing with the host side of things. Debian and Kicksecure should be identical in this regard.)
